name: miton3
desc: pixel art RPG game character sprite, front view, standing still: miton, a pig. A simple straight tube-shaped body like a kokeshi doll, the head as wide as the body, no neck. Smooth pale pink pig skin everywhere, NO wool, NO fur, NO hood, NOT a llama, NOT an alpaca. A round pig face: a big round flat pig snout with two nostrils, small pointed pig ears on top, small black eyes behind round wire glasses, a tiny smiling mouth, a pearl necklace around the top of the body. Calm elegant old lady

refs.use: the author's sketch of miton: a pig face with round glasses and a pearl necklace on a straight tube body. follow this shape
